name: com.tractorstore.TractorStoreApplication
comment:
Main entry point of The Tractor Store Backend.

Modular Monolith architecture using Spring Modulith. Each business domain is isolated in its own package:

  • {@code catalog} - Product catalog and categories
  • {@code inventory} - Stock management per SKU
  • {@code cart} - Shopping cart sessions
  • {@code order} - Order lifecycle management
  • {@code notifications} - Event-driven notifications

Modules communicate exclusively via Domain Events (Spring Modulith). Direct cross-module dependencies are forbidden and enforced at test time.

name: com.tractorstore.infrastructure.config.SecurityConfig
comment:
Security configuration for The Tractor Store backend.

Current phase: Basic configuration allowing public access to documentation and monitoring endpoints. JWT authentication will be implemented in HU-17 (Spring Security JWT).

Public endpoints:

  • Swagger UI and OpenAPI docs
  • Spring Actuator health and info

All API endpoints under /api/** will require JWT authentication once HU-17 is implemented.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.comment: Configures the security filter chain. Stateless session — no HTTP session created. CSRF disabled (REST API, not form-based).

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.comment: CORS configuration — allows requests from Angular MFE apps. In production, restrict origins to the actual deployed domains.
